description: This file is a shell script implementing the IPv6-in-IPv4 tunneling backend for OpenWrt. It contains functions to set up, update, and tear down 6in4 tunnels, including IP address configuration, route management, and tunnel broker integration.

methods.name: test_6in4_rfc1918
methods.description: Checks if an IPv4 address falls within private or reserved ranges as per RFC 1918 and RFC 6598.

methods.name: proto_6in4_update
methods.description: Runs the given command with a timeout mechanism, used for updating tunnel status.

methods.name: proto_6in4_add_prefix
methods.description: Adds an IPv6 prefix to the tunnel's configuration.

methods.name: proto_6in4_setup
methods.description: Sets up a 6in4 tunnel with specified configuration parameters, including IP addresses, routes, and tunnel broker updates.

methods.name: proto_6in4_init_config
methods.description: Initializes configuration parameters and options for the 6in4 protocol.
